hits.title: Syngenta Group Appoints New Chief Executive Officer for 2026
hits.snippet: Hengde Qin will become Syngenta Group CEO in August 2026, replacing Jeff Rowe after nearly a decade at the company. The Board of Directors of the Swiss Syngenta Group, one of the world’s largest players in the crop protection and seed markets, has unanimously appointed Hende Qin as its new CEO. He will take office on August 1, 2026, succeeding Jeff Rowe, who will return to the United States after nearly 10 years with the company. The new CEO will be based in Basel, Switzerland, where he has been working since January 2023. Qin has been a member of the Syngenta Group’s executive team since 2020. During this time, he has served as Chief Financial Officer, Chief Human Resources Officer, and President of Syngenta Group China, and has also become a member of the company’s Board of Directors. Before joining Syngenta, Qin led two publicly traded companies in mainland China and Hong Kong.

August weiterführen, bevor er in die USA zurückkehrt, wie der Konzern mitteilte. Syngenta mit Sitz in der Schweiz ist eine Tochtergesellschaft des chinesischen Staatskonzerns China National Chemical, bekannt als ChemChina. Der Unternehmen ist der größte Anbieter von Pflanzenschutzmitteln in den USA und ein bedeutender Lieferant von Saatgut und konkurriert unter anderem mit Bayer. Rowe, ein Landwirt aus Illinois in fünfter Generation und ehemaliger Manager bei DuPont Pioneer, leitete den größten Geschäftsbereich von Syngenta, bevor er im Januar 2024 zum CEO ernannt wurde. Er steuerte das Unternehmen durch eine schwierige Agrarkonjunktur, die das Geschäft unter Druck gesetzt hatte und verwarf Pläne für einen Börsengang an der Shanghai Stock Exchange unter Verweis wegen des aktuellen Branchenumfeldes. results.name: Hengde Qin Named Syngenta Group CEO, Replacing Jeff Rowe - News and Statistics - IndexBox
results.content:
Syngenta Group names Hengde Qin as new CEO, effective August 1, 2026, succeeding Jeff Rowe. Qin, a veteran executive since 2020, previously led Syngenta Group China to strong growth and profitability.
Syngenta Group has appointed Hengde Qin as its new chief executive officer, effective August 1, according to a company announcement published on July 1, 2026.
Qin has been part of Syngenta Group's executive leadership team since 2020, holding senior positions in business, finance, human resources, and global operations. During his time at the company, he served as chief financial officer, chief human resources officer for Syngenta Group, and president of Syngenta Group China.
In his role leading the China business, he oversaw a period of strong growth and improved profitability, making it one of the company's best-performing operations. He also sits on Syngenta Group's board of directors.
Before joining Syngenta, Qin was chief executive officer of two publicly listed companies in mainland China and Hong Kong.

results.name: Syngenta Group Appoints Hengde Qin as Chief Executive Officer
results.content:
Syngenta Group today announced that its Board of Directors has unanimously appointed Hengde Qin as Chief Executive Officer, effective August 1, 2026, following a thorough nomination and succession process.
Together with Syngenta’s talented employees around the world, we will continue to innovate, create lasting value for our customers, and deliver more breakthroughs for farmers, in every field.” · Qin previously held CEO positions at two publicly listed companies in mainland China and Hong Kong.
Rowe joined Syngenta in September 2016 and was responsible for the successful turnaround of the Seeds business, which saw strong growth and a return to profitability. He then went on to lead the Crop Protection business, the company's largest business unit, before taking over as CEO.
Qin, currently Chief Operating Officer and Head of Seeds, succeeds Jeff Rowe, who will remain in the role through August 1 before returning to the United States after nearly 10 years with the company. Fanrong Li, Chairman of the Board of Directors, said “The Board of Directors believes Hengde, a highly respected leader who boasts a unique combination of operational, financial and commercial experience is the best candidate for the role. We are confident that Hengde will take Syngenta Group to the next level of its sustainable development and value creation.
Qin will be based in company headquarters in Basel, Switzerland, where he has been located since January 2023. He has served on Syngenta Group's executive team since 2020, holding senior roles across the business, finance, human resources, and global operations.

results.name: Syngenta Group Appoints New Chief Executive Officer for 2026
results.content:
Hengde Qin will become Syngenta Group CEO in August 2026, replacing Jeff Rowe after nearly a decade at the company.
The Board of Directors of the Swiss Syngenta Group, one of the world’s largest players in the crop protection and seed markets, has unanimously appointed Hende Qin as its new CEO. He will take office on August 1, 2026, succeeding Jeff Rowe, who will return to the United States after nearly 10 years with the company.
The new CEO will be based in Basel, Switzerland, where he has been working since January 2023. Qin has been a member of the Syngenta Group’s executive team since 2020. During this time, he has served as Chief Financial Officer, Chief Human Resources Officer, and President of Syngenta Group China, and has also become a member of the company’s Board of Directors.
Before joining Syngenta, Qin led two publicly traded companies in mainland China and Hong Kong.

results.name: Syngenta Group Appoints Hengde Qin as CEO Effective August 1, 2026 - News and Statistics - IndexBox
results.content:
Syngenta Group appoints Hengde Qin as CEO from August 1, 2026, replacing Jeff Rowe. Qin's operational and financial experience aligns with the company's focus on capital markets readiness and a potential Hong Kong IPO.
Syngenta Group has chosen Hengde Qin as its next chief executive officer, with the change effective August 1, 2026, following what the firm termed a comprehensive nomination and succession process.
Rowe will stay in his position until the handover and then go back to the United States from Syngenta Group's main office in Basel after roughly ten years with the organization. Chairman Fanrong Li remarked that Qin's distinctive blend of operational, financial, and commercial expertise made him the suitable candidate to guide Syngenta into its subsequent growth stage.
A veteran member of the executive team, Qin has occupied senior positions covering finance, operations, and human resources, including roles as chief financial officer and president of Syngenta Group China.
The selection represents a shift from within the organization rather than a strategic change, implying that the company remains largely assured of its current path. Although Syngenta has not directly tied the appointment to its much-awaited Hong Kong initial public offering, Qin's background closely matches what investors generally anticipate from leadership ahead of a public listing.

results.content:
DJ Agrarchemiekonzern Syngenta ernennt neuen CEO  
Von Patrick Thomas  
DOW JONES--Der CEO des Agrarchemiekonzerns Syngenta, Jeff Rowe, tritt Anfang August von der Konzernspitze zurück. Zu seinem Nachfolger wurde der operative Vorstand (COO) und ehemalige Leiter des China-Geschäfts, Hengde Qin, bestellt. Rowe wird seine Position bis zum 1. August weiterführen, bevor er in die USA zurückkehrt, wie der Konzern mitteilte.  
Syngenta mit Sitz in der Schweiz ist eine Tochtergesellschaft des chinesischen Staatskonzerns China National Chemical, bekannt als ChemChina. Der Unternehmen ist der größte Anbieter von Pflanzenschutzmitteln in den USA und ein bedeutender Lieferant von Saatgut und konkurriert unter anderem mit Bayer.  
Rowe, ein Landwirt aus Illinois in fünfter Generation und ehemaliger Manager bei DuPont Pioneer, leitete den größten Geschäftsbereich von Syngenta, bevor er im Januar 2024 zum CEO ernannt wurde. Er steuerte das Unternehmen durch eine schwierige Agrarkonjunktur, die das Geschäft unter Druck gesetzt hatte und verwarf Pläne für einen Börsengang an der Shanghai Stock Exchange unter Verweis wegen des aktuellen Branchenumfeldes.

snippets.snippet: DJ Agrarchemiekonzern Syngenta ernennt neuen CEO Von Patrick Thomas DOW JONES--Der CEO des Agrarchemiekonzerns Syngenta, Jeff Rowe, tritt Anfang August von der Konzernspitze zurück. Zu seinem Nachfolger wurde der operative Vorstand (COO) und ehemalige Leiter des China-Geschäfts, Hengde Qin, bestellt. Rowe wird seine Position bis zum 1. August weiterführen, bevor er in die USA zurückkehrt, wie der Konzern mitteilte. Syngenta mit Sitz in der Schweiz ist eine Tochtergesellschaft des chinesischen Staatskonzerns China National Chemical, bekannt als ChemChina. Der Unternehmen ist der größte Anbieter von Pflanzenschutzmitteln in den USA und ein bedeutender Lieferant von Saatgut und konkurriert unter anderem mit Bayer. Rowe, ein Landwirt aus Illinois in fünfter Generation und ehemaliger Manager bei DuPont Pioneer, leitete den größten Geschäftsbereich von Syngenta, bevor er im Januar 2024 zum CEO ernannt wurde. Er steuerte das Unternehmen durch eine schwierige Agrarkonjunktur, die das Geschäft unter Druck gesetzt hatte und verwarf Pläne für einen Börsengang an der Shanghai Stock Exchange unter Verweis wegen des aktuellen Branchenumfeldes.
